facts.value: Dispatches state indices 0, 1 and 2, whose table animation identifiers are 0, 1 and -1 respectively. State 0 runs shared appearance updates and landing handling. State 1 restarts its state initialization when the shared animation test returns zero, schedules randomized sound through it_80275288(gobj, 4, 0x2730) on an exactly zero interval, and decrements the lifetime before testing expiration. Support loss enters state 2, whose local animation callback is inert and whose physics and qualified landing path return the item to state 1. The interval and lifetime are not reset by these local falling/landing transitions, and state 2 does not locally tick them.

facts.rationale: Preserves numeric edge cases and distinguishes exact-zero sound scheduling from decrement-then-nonpositive lifetime expiration.
facts.value: The state-reinitialization test and sound-interval test are independent. Only an exactly zero x64 reloads attrs->x8 and dispatches randomized audio; x64 is then decremented unconditionally. This is not a nonpositive expiration test: negative or fractional values that never reach exactly zero do not trigger a reload, and a zero reload value becomes -1 after the call. Lifetime handling separately subtracts 1.0f and returns true only when the result is <= 0. State reinitialization does not reload either timer.

facts.rationale: Replaces the potentially misleading enforced-maximum interpretation with the canonical pre-update threshold behavior.
facts.value: Delegates state-2 vertical falling physics to it_80272860 using generic fall acceleration and maximum-speed attributes. For ordinary positive acceleration, the helper subtracts acceleration when velocity is nonnegative or its downward magnitude is below the configured threshold. It does not clamp the resulting velocity, so an update can overshoot that threshold.

evidence.why: Physics wrapper and independent landing callback.
Exact conditional velocity update.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes unconditional delegation from conditional mutation and retains the helper's nonstandard sign/threshold branches.
facts.value: Every invocation calls the shared vertical-physics helper, but not every invocation changes velocity. The helper subtracts acceleration when the signs of velocity and acceleration agree; when their signs differ, it subtracts only if the current velocity magnitude is below the supplied threshold. The callback has no local timer or transition, and the separate collision callback determines whether a qualified landing returns through it_802D705C.
